SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
WHERE fiscal_period = 2
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT 
  ds.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) as sales_lines,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
  AND ds.store_id < 900
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format

calls.statement:
WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.format,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY ds.format
),
return_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.format,
    SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as units_returned,
    SUM(frl.refund_net) as net_returns
  FROM fact_return_line frl
  INNER JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON frl.sales_line_id = fsl.sales_line_id
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 2
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY ds.format
)
SELECT 
  s.format,
  s.units_sold,
  COALESCE(r.units_returned, 0) as units_returned,
  ROUND(COALESCE(r.units_returned, 0) * 100.0 / s.units_sold, 2) as return_rate_pct,
  s.net_sales,
  COALESCE(r.net_returns, 0) as net_returns
FROM sales_data s
LEFT JOIN return_data r ON s.format = r.format
ORDER BY s.format
